terra.problem: The line says “kings fell” at Ramoth-gilead, but the cited passages say only that Ahab died there. Joram was wounded, not killed.
“A city of refuge” describes Ramoth’s designation, but Joshua 20:1–9 does not show that designation happening at Ramoth-gilead.
“Ahab wants the city back” concerns Ramoth-gilead, but 1 Kings 22:1–4 does not place the conversation there.
“Prophets say go to war” takes place at the gate of Samaria, not at Ramoth-gilead (1 Kings 22:10).
